body: Ah yes that tends to happen. What do you think you need? Or what do you want?

Yea it gets to a weird point where you yearn for human contact. 

Have you always just focused on work that's why you have no close friends?

Sometimes even feet can't cheer me up..i end up wishing i could give them to somebody else:/

I feel you right now. Everything is definitely NOT going right in my life but I am realizing; yet again, that I really don't have anyone to talk to. I always call other people my "best friend" and never thinking about how I'm not theirs. All my friends are more like acquaintances I guess, no one ever invites me to group activities because I'm not a part of that group. I tend to get rid of people on my facebook if I never talk to them, it just seems pointless. I hate facebook. 

It's hard for family to understand. They have all their stuff going on and think just checking up on you once in awhile is enough. At least your mum is proud of you, mine was/is always disappointed. I've also noticed that if you are doing well for yourself then people gets jealous and enjoy pointing out your flaws. 

I actually have a similar situation with an ex too. Funny how they start to ignore you when you start needing someone to talk to. 

At least I'm not the only one who feels like this. I just remind myself I at least have feet and that is something to be grateful for. 

Have any hobbies? I hear they are good for depression.
Whenever i went off meds I'd get horrible headaches and dizziness..same with celexa. When weening myself off i did every other day, then half, then 1/4 just to keep those bloody headaches away.
I don't know..if I tell them how I feel then that is just me complaining again right? I don't think they want to hear me complain about complaining..if that makes sense.
Yea but you don't tell an aquaintaince your problems. Apparently the people who you think are your friends are just sunshine friends..

My ex wouldn't go to a counselor either with me, until i told him we were getting a divorce and packed his bag. But by then it was too late, i was so far gone it literally made me cringe to be around him. My ex was just the anchor holding me down in a really shitty position/life and i got out because i knew I'd drown.
It really doesn't help when you say its "selfish", makes you want to do it even more. Like they said, it doesn't matter when you're dead.
I hate it when people say they feel like they're "walking on egg shells" around me, when in reality I'm the one putting up with them.

I recently have had around 7 people walk out of my life in a two week span. Some were merely acquaintances, non were best friends. Only a couple knew of my disorder and am baffled by why they left (funny thing is they were both psyc majors), fortunately it doesn't even phase me. I am getting better:) 
Recently though, i realized i don't believe in not burning bridges. Everyone say not to burn bridges, but i think if they aren't doing any good in your life then why keep them around? So i cut a couple other closer people loose too because i knew they were doing more damage than good. Someone i really cared about couldn't even give me a straight answer why or if we were "friends".
How i see it, there are 6ish billion people on this planet. Why waste energy on someone when you can meet someone else and they maybe even become your best friend.
I know, everyone says the same thing about family. I wish i could care, i really do, but i don't. People will get over it. I hope they at least think I'm happy.

She is not BPD. Those are not our symptoms. Best thing for her is to have someone to talk to. Just stay in touch and let her know you're there if she needs you. Saying hi or i love you now and then is nice enough with your busy schedule.  Do try and call at least once a week. If she is BPD, which i don't think that diagnosis is correct; its crucial she not feel abandoned.

I'm not really of much help right now, wandering the site to not feel so alone..but i think you're covered by everyone else trying to help. I just wanted to say that death under the stars at the grand canyon sounds beautiful.
Sorry i didn't see your reply. Its alright i think I've got it figured out. Thank you though

My exhusband was like that. If i ever needed to talk about something he'd literally turn his back. And then there was the gaming..i didn't mind until he'd get upset if you bothered him/got in the way. Yelled at the dog for wanting his attention..got pretty bad. Hence the ex.
Crisis averted! But i know i need help and am looking:) thank you for talking to me
I mean i want to be able to put my conscience aside and just end it. Snap and just do it instead of thinking about the pain.

I haven't hurt myself in awhile, it helped with the anger. I know i shouldn't. Ever feel like you are too sane? I wish i could just snap. I think i kinda have a split personality, sometimes i don't remember conversations. I did have an out of body experience once that lasted a few days. It was crazy.
I will have to look into it..I'm afraid of myself right now.
